name: Camp Bishopswood
description_short: Episcopal coed overnight camp on Lake Megunticook in Hope, Maine. It offers one-week Youth Camps or multi-week sessions for ages 8 to 16, short Mini Camps for ages 6 to 8, a Counselor-in-Training program, and one week of day camp for ages 6 to 12. Families choose one of three price tiers.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Lake Megunticook. Each cabin group goes to the waterfront every morning for an hour of swimming and water safety instruction.

warnings: The page never states the season year. I chose 2027 because the weekdays it gives fit 2027: 'Sat, July 24', 'Sunday, July 25' and a five-day Day Camp from Aug 23 to 27 (Mon–Fri in 2027). But the page also says 'Fri, July 3', which only fits 2026, a season that has already ended. The footer reads '© Copyright 2025'. These may be last season's dates and prices. Check with the camp before relying on them.

Prices use a voluntary three-tier sliding scale where families pick their tier. Each session's price is the Tier 1 (lowest, subsidized) rate. The session name lists all three tiers. Tier 2 is described as 'the true cost of camp.'
price_per_week is left blank because this is mainly an overnight camp. A one-week Youth Camp costs $1,271–$1,877 depending on tier. The single Day Camp week costs $475–$650.
There is a session break between YC4 and YC5. Campers staying on must be picked up Sat, July 24 and come back Sun, July 25.
The activities list comes mostly from former staff stories on the page, not from an official program list.
Mini Camp dates are recorded as given on the page.
